name: Stag
soul: The soul of one who holds their head up in any company, and is easier under trees than under a roof.
spark: The mote stays at the edge of the lamplight and goes still when you look straight at it.

hybrid.text: It holds its ground with its head up, and what it carries on that head grows every season.

settled.name: Fawn
settled.text: Legs it has not learned yet, and no crown. It startles at the bowl-fire and then stands in front of you as if it had not.
settled.sign: All leg, with two soft bumps where the crown will be. It stands very straight when it is frightened.
settled.habit: It freezes when a door opens, then steps in front of you as if that had been the plan.

paths.name: Tilter
paths.of: one who cannot back down once challenged
paths.text: It learned from you that once the head is down there is no dignified way to lift it. It goes straight at the thing.
paths.sign: It carries its head low and forward. The brow is thick, and scuffed from doors.
paths.habit: It squares up to anything that looks back at it: a gatepost, a statue, its own reflection.

prongs.name: Locked-horn
prongs.of: one who holds an argument in place until a friend arrives
prongs.text: It takes the foe's blow on its tines and holds it there while you work.
prongs.sign: A deep chest and a neck like a root. The tines are scored where others have locked on them.
prongs.habit: It pushes, gently and for a long time, against any wall it stands beside.

finishes.name: Twelve-point
finishes.of: one whose every stand shows on them
finishes.text: Every season you stood your ground it grew a tine. Count them.
finishes.sign: Twelve tines, evenly grown. People count them, and it holds still to be counted.
finishes.habit: It stands on the highest ground in view with its head up, doing nothing at all.

finishes.name: Scarred Royal
finishes.of: one who lost something to pride and kept the pride
finishes.text: The crown is chipped and one tine is gone. It lowers it just the same.
finishes.sign: A chipped crown with one tine gone, and a hide gone dark and hard over old cuts.
finishes.habit: It lowers its head to every newcomer, the broken side first.

prongs.name: Long Charge
prongs.of: one who is across the room before thinking better of it
prongs.text: It crosses the ground before the foe has finished winding up.
prongs.sign: Longer in the leg than a stag should be, and always gathered, as if on a slope.
prongs.habit: It paces the longest straight line the room allows.

finishes.name: Break-line Stag
finishes.of: one who goes through rather than round
finishes.text: It goes through a pack the way the car goes through a snowdrift.
finishes.sign: Its hooves are broad and set square, and it leaves a straight track through anything.
finishes.habit: It walks through gaps in hedges that were not gaps before.

finishes.name: Ghost-runner
finishes.of: one who runs it off alone, at night
finishes.text: It runs with you alone at night, and is only ever seen where it has already been.
finishes.sign: Grey at the edges in poor light. You see its breath before you see it.
finishes.habit: It is gone at midnight and back by morning with wet legs.

prongs.name: Belling Stag
prongs.of: one who announces themselves before they arrive
prongs.text: It bells when your Pattern is ready, and the foe looks round.
prongs.sign: A throat that swells before it calls. Heads turn a moment before the sound.
prongs.habit: It bells once at first light, facing whatever is largest.

finishes.name: Oath-crowned
finishes.of: one who wears their promises where all can read them
finishes.text: It carries your sworn Terms cut into its beam. It will not let you forget how many there are.
finishes.sign: Lines of small writing are cut into the main beam of each antler.
finishes.habit: It rubs its beam on the doorpost before you go out, and the cut letters show clean.

finishes.name: Thunder-beller
finishes.of: one whose voice lands like a blow
finishes.text: Its call lands on the Pattern's beat, and the chain is one blow longer for it.
finishes.sign: The air rings round its head a breath after it has called.
finishes.habit: It answers thunder, and waits to see if thunder has anything further.

paths.name: Wood-walker
paths.of: one who is easier under trees than under a roof
paths.text: It learned from you that some people are only themselves out of doors. Under trees it stops looking for the way out.
paths.sign: Moss on the brow-tines and leaf-mould to the hock. Indoors it stands by the window.
paths.habit: It walks out at dusk without asking and is found at the tree line, looking in.

prongs.name: Ward-hart
prongs.of: one who tends a boundary because it is theirs
prongs.text: It walks your wards as you lay them, and they hold a little better for it.
prongs.sign: A pale ring hangs in its crown, and the grass is greener where it has stood.
prongs.habit: It walks the same circle round your camp each evening, and the circle holds.

finishes.name: Garden-crowned
finishes.of: one in whose keeping things grow
finishes.text: Its crown flowers in the Thaw. Wards you plant under it do not fail before morning.
finishes.sign: Its crown buds in the Thaw and flowers by midsummer. Bees follow it.
finishes.habit: It stands over anything newly planted until the first rain.

finishes.name: Bridge-hart
finishes.of: one who finds the way across and waits there
finishes.text: It finds the ford. Where there is none, it stands in the current until there is.
finishes.sign: Wet to the chest, with broad splayed hooves and river weed in its tines.
finishes.habit: It wades into any water it meets and stands midstream, looking back.

prongs.name: White Hart
prongs.of: one who notices first and says least
prongs.text: It is seen a moment before something happens. Follow where it looks.
prongs.sign: Pale as milk, and always seen side-on, at a distance, looking somewhere else.
prongs.habit: It lifts its head and looks one way for a long moment. Then something happens there.

finishes.name: Hart of Omens
finishes.of: one who will say plainly that today is not the day
finishes.text: It stands at the mouth of the deep places and will not go in on a bad day. Go in anyway and see.
finishes.sign: A pale mark like an eye on its brow, which seems to be looking when it is not.
finishes.habit: It stops at thresholds and thinks about them.

finishes.name: Quiet Hart
finishes.of: one whose company is a place to rest
finishes.text: In the Quiet it is the only thing that still looks alive. Stay beside it.
finishes.sign: The air is still for a pace round it. Its breath shows and nothing else moves.
finishes.habit: It lies down in the open, and things come and lie down near it.

prongs.name: Thorn-hide
prongs.of: one who grew a rough coat because the soft one cost too much
prongs.text: It took what was meant for you until its coat grew to meet it.
prongs.sign: Its hide stands in thick overlapping plates along the flank, like bark.
prongs.habit: It scratches against thorn trees by choice, and is the calmer for it.

finishes.name: Bramble King
finishes.of: one who made a home in what keeps others out
finishes.text: Thorn and briar grow in its crown now. What strikes it bleeds for the trouble.
finishes.sign: Briar grows through its crown and flowers there. Small birds nest in it.
finishes.habit: It beds down in the middle of a thicket and comes out unmarked.

finishes.name: Winter Hart
finishes.of: one who is at their best when the year is at its worst
finishes.text: Your cold is in it. Its breath stands in the air after it has gone.
finishes.sign: Frost on every tine, and breath that hangs behind it in the shape it had.
finishes.habit: It stands out in the first snow with its eyes shut.

paths.name: Watch-hart
paths.of: one who walks at the back and sees everyone home
paths.text: It learned from you that the one who keeps watch does not get to graze.
paths.sign: One ear forward and one back, and its head is the last to go down at any stop.
paths.habit: It grazes only when someone else is standing, and then quickly.

prongs.name: Herd-hart
prongs.of: one who keeps the stragglers in view
prongs.text: It walks at the back of the party and turns its head at every sound.
prongs.sign: It walks last, and its eyes rest longest on whoever is limping.
prongs.habit: It nudges the slowest sleeper awake first, so that they are not last again.

finishes.name: Hart of the Cohort
finishes.text: Your classmates touch its flank going out, for luck. It allows this.
finishes.sign: One flank is worn smooth and faintly bright where twelve hands have touched it.
finishes.habit: It stands at the gate at setting-out time and turns its flank to each who passes.

finishes.name: Fawn-minder
finishes.of: one who cannot see a stranger go unsheltered
finishes.text: Whoever you are bringing home walks inside the reach of its crown.
finishes.sign: It carries its crown low and wide, and whoever is smallest is walking under it.
finishes.habit: It stands over anyone asleep in the open.

prongs.name: Post-hart
prongs.of: one who will not lie down until the job has taken
prongs.text: It stands at a relit post until the flame takes, and has never once lain down there.
prongs.sign: A lamp hangs from one brow-tine. Its knees are grey with standing.
prongs.habit: It stands at the last lit place and watches the flame, not the dark.

finishes.name: Lamp-crowned
finishes.of: one who carries the light from where it is to where it is needed
finishes.text: It carries a post's flame in its tines from the car to the lamp, and has not dropped one.
finishes.sign: A small flame sits in the fork of its crown and does not catch the velvet.
finishes.habit: It walks with its head very level, even when there is nothing in its crown.

finishes.name: Stone Hart
finishes.of: one who stays where they were asked, long after the asking
finishes.text: It stood so long where you told it that moss tried it. It did not mind.
finishes.sign: Moss on its back and lichen on its crown. It is the grey of the stone it stood beside.
finishes.habit: It stands where you left it. It is there when you return.

prongs.name: Grave Hart
prongs.of: one who still sets a place for those who did not come home
prongs.text: It grazes where the hall's dead are named, and the shades ride it out at the lamp hour.
prongs.sign: A cold light in the chest, and frost on the grass where it grazes.
prongs.habit: It grazes among the name-stones at dusk and lifts its head at each.

finishes.name: Trophy-rack
finishes.of: one who keeps a token of every hard thing done
finishes.text: It wears a token in its crown for every named beast you felled. They clatter when it runs.
finishes.sign: Teeth, tags and bits of collar hang in its crown on wire. They clatter at a trot.
finishes.habit: It shakes its head once at the gate, so that the hall hears who is home.

finishes.name: Hearth Hart
finishes.of: one the dead are glad to hear on the step
finishes.text: The shades know its step. When it comes in from the dark they stop talking and listen.
finishes.sign: Its eyes are older than its crown, and its step in the hall is slow and known.
finishes.habit: It comes in from the dark at the lamp hour and stands by the hearth until the talk begins again.
